title: Executions
changes: Break a monster's guard (the dizzy stars) and a red arrow shows over it: your next blow is an execution that deals double damage (x1.5 on elites and bosses).
An execution also cools your Heat by 30%, or gives back 10% of your Mana as a Wizard or Summoner.
One execution per break, and only your own attacks and skills count, not your creatures.
